title: Grandpa's Greatest Treasure #shorts

lines.text: Grandpa always said, when I die, you'll inherit my greatest treasure.
Everyone laughed. He was a retired mailman who collected bottle caps.
When he passed away, my cousins fought over the house, the car, even the mailbox.
All I got was one rusty key and a note: Open the attic. Alone.
That night, I climbed the creaky stairs. Something moved in the dark.
I screamed. Then my little sister screamed even louder.
Why are we in the attic?!
In the corner sat an old trunk, full of letters. Every single one had my name.
One for every birthday, until I turn forty.
I cried. My sister cried. Then I opened the last one.
Kiddo, the real treasure is this: I will never miss a birthday. P.S. The bottle caps are worthless. Sorry.
I laughed and cried at the same time.
